traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. The trine makes this a natural strength: Imaginative ideas that turn out to have practical application. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Growth and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what growth and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
shadow: The ease lets excess and overreach and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: A dream can start feeling less like an escape and more like something that could receive a practical place in ordinary life.
readerCopy.body: A dream can start feeling less like an escape and more like something that could receive a practical place in ordinary life. When Jupiter trines Neptune, imagination and confidence support each other, helping a creative idea, compassionate goal, or long-held hope attract more attention and belief. You may find it easier to take an idea seriously before every step has been worked out. Giving the vision some time, money, or effort can reveal what becomes possible once it has a place beside already established priorities.
